items.source:
Encapsulates the aggregation framework $bucketAuto-operation.
Bucket stage is typically used with Aggregation and $facet. Categorizes incoming documents into a specific number of groups, called buckets, based on a specified expression. Bucket boundaries are automatically determined in an attempt to evenly distribute the documents into the specified number of buckets.
We recommend to use the static factory method Aggregation.bucketAuto(String, int) instead of creating instances of this class directly.
items.translation:
封装了聚合框架中的 `$bucketAuto` 操作。
Bucket 阶段通常与 Aggregation 和 $facet 一起使用。它根据指定的表达式将传入的文档分类到特定数量的组（称为 bucket）中。Bucket 的边界会自动确定，以尝试将文档均匀地分配到指定数量的 bucket 中。
我们建议使用静态工厂方法 Aggregation.bucketAuto(String, int) 来创建实例，而不是直接创建此类对象。

items.source:
Configures granularity that specifies the preferred number series to use to ensure that the calculated boundary edges end on preferred round numbers or their powers of 10 and return a new BucketAutoOperation.
Use either predefined BucketAutoOperation.Granularities or provide a own one.
items.translation:
配置granularity，该参数指定首选的数系列，以确保计算出的边界边缘结束于首选的整数或其 10 的幂次上，并返回一个新的BucketAutoOperation。
可以使用预定义的BucketAutoOperation.Granularities，或者提供自定义的数系列。
